feedback: The archive, manual-entry form and category reporting provide a clear expense-management structure. Persist invoices before calling them completed: a ₹100 test entry updated totals but disappeared after reload, and the report’s ₹6,196.48 savings does not match its displayed 25.17% rate on ₹19,364.
tested: Inspected Dashboard, Archive, Tax Reports and Preferences; created synthetic ₹100 QA Demo Stationery invoice, confirmed six receipts and ₹19,464 total, then reloaded and observed five receipts and ₹19,364. Reviewed tax report figures and jurisdiction labels.
limitations: Receipt-image OCR and file exports not verified; no real financial information entered, no existing invoice or entity details changed. Financial correctness not legally assessed; reported discrepancy is arithmetic and persistent state.
name: Deevij Patel

feedback: The recipe-to-weekly-plan flow works well: adding dishes builds groceries, updates calories and retains meals and checked ingredients after reload. Improve serving-size control and grocery aggregation, and avoid clipping the final day column so the entire week remains easy to use.
tested: Opened embedded artifact, searched Masala Dosa, inspected detailed recipe, added to Monday, checked a grocery ingredient and verified both after reload. Changed daily target to 300 and added Tuesday; both 350-calorie days displayed over-target styling and grocery multiplication.
limitations: Recipe nutrition and source accuracy not independently verified. No account changes, sharing or external messages; tested only local meal-planning state.
name: Prachi Purohit

feedback: The counter-offer loop provides responsive opponent dialogue, changing offers, distinct resolution paths and a history that survives reload. Make the learning score consistent with the stated targets: an 11.2 LPA deal below the 12–15 target counted as a win, while walking away above the 10 LPA floor was labelled “Walkaway Breached.”
tested: Played salary scenario using firm request, benchmark and ambitious anchor; offer moved 10.5→10.8→11→11.2 LPA. Accepted deal, received42/100, reloaded and verified history. Inspected archetype codex, started again and walked away, producing separate65/100 result and50% deal-close rate.
limitations: No real negotiation or financial transaction. Other scenario categories, round-limit termination and all archetypes not exhaustively tested; general negotiation teaching claims unverified.

tested: Inspected Maintenance, How it Works, Pricing, Results and booking form; dragged before/after comparison, changed to yearly billing, opened Monthly Plan checkout showing ₹8148 yearly, and switched UPI to Card input. Reload reset the public pricing toggle to monthly.
limitations: No customer or payment data entered, auto-pay authorized, audit requested or booking made. Payment processing, service fulfilment, monitoring and promotional/certification claims unverified. Lower-page roadmap explicitly labels monitoring hardware and automated scheduling as not live yet.
